one year.

reviewer_notes: Single application (industrial ethane decarbonization unit, South Pars Gas Complex, Iran) and one energy performance model (GBM regression predicting steam flow rate as an energy baseline). The k-means clustering identifies operating states for ECO quantification but is not itself an energy performance model, so it is recorded only as a segmentation adaptation. Sector registered as petroleum refining by inference — the paper self-describes as a 'gas refinery' within the oil-and-gas refining context; reviewer may prefer 'continuous chemical production' given it is a gas-treating (amine absorption) unit. Reported R2=0.99, RMSE=108.8 kg.hr−1 and RMAE=0.14% are all on the 20% holdout validation set (out-of-sample); no in-sample fit metric is separately reported. Variable selection combined a multicollinearity study (dropped 7 variables) with random forest feature-importance ranking, hence coded 'other'. Coefficients coded not applicable because GBM is a tree ensemble; hyperparameters (n_estimators=500, learning_rate=0.01, max_depth=20) are reported instead.
